name: What should I check before buying a new toilet for my bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What should I check before buying a new toilet for my bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A toilet should be selected for the room’s clearances, rough-in measurement, bowl shape, seat height, flush performance, and cleaning needs—not just its appearance. Replacing an existing toilet may be straightforward, but a new location or different rough-in can affect flooring, drainage, framing, and inspection work. Elite Remodeling & Design can coordinate fixture selection with the overall bathroom layout. Key factors include: - Existing drain and supply positions - Distance from walls and adjacent fixtures - User comfort and accessibility - Availability of replacement parts. Measure the existing rough-in and confirm the manufacturer’s dimensions before ordering. Keep the product specification available for the installer and avoid substitutions without checking fit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Confirm the rough-in, bowl shape, height, clearances, supply location, flush system, seat compatibility, and replacement-part availability. A different toilet can affect flooring, drainage, or adjacent fixture spacing, so verify dimensions before ordering.
